entries.introZh: 以苏丹干涸湖水中重新露出的古庙为背景，围绕考古工地、神庙和地下空间构建交火场景。
entries.descriptionOriginal: fy_summer - Temple of Taharqa It was the hottest summer northern Sudan had ever seen. For weeks the sun burned without mercy, and the great lake began to shrink. Then, one morning, an obelisk broke the surface. As the water pulled back, the lost Kushite Temple of Taharqa emerged from the sand - one of the few left behind when the valley was flooded decades ago. Archaeologists rushed in before the water could return. They fenced off the site, raised scaffolding along its walls and began uncovering the temple stone by stone. What they found beneath it changed everything. The basement, still half drowned, had never been touched - offerings, sealed jars and gold, guarded only by skeletons. Some are thousands of years old. Some are not. The discovery was meant to stay secret, but word travels fast. A band of armed smugglers has stormed the dig site, determined to strip the temple and sell its treasures on the black market to fund their war. Counter-terrorist forces are sent to secure it. The heat is unbearable, and the window is closing. Summer won't last forever. When the rains return, the river will take its temple back - and whoever is still inside. The layout of the map is inspired by fy_summer from CS 1.6, originally created by BuFFer. The map has been completely rebuilt from scratch with many improvements, keeping the spirit of the original while giving it a fresh and refined experience. ☀️ fy_summer is the first Madness Gaming map where time moves. With every round, the sun travels a little further across the sky, shifting the light and shadows as the match goes on. Just like in the story - the clock is ticking. ⚡This map was created by the Madness Gaming EU team as part of our ongoing effort to revive the fy maps experience. It will be added to the Fy_War server pool, with more maps of this kind planned for the near future. Play today: connect fywar.madnessgaming.eu:25601
